verdict.rationale: LM Studio's docs state that you can attach documents to chat messages and interact with them entirely offline via RAG. The 0.3.0 release notes describe built-in functionality to give documents to any local model and ask questions about them. A community user also mentions a RAG plugin, which corroborates the claim. Missing for 10: detail on how retrieval is triggered automatically (chunking, embedding, when RAG engages vs. full-context injection) and hands-on reports of retrieval quality.
